item.title: Youth job program CEO trains Gen Z in workplace etiquette and emails
item.description: Byron V. Garrett, CEO of Genesys Works, says employers want workers who are ready, so the program trains thousands of underserved U.S. teens.

item.title: 37% of parents rely on baby boomer financial help amid affordability crisis
item.description: Childcare costs have led many families to seek help from their parents before the Great Wealth Transfer.

item.title: Billionaire invests fortune in Texas ghost town with no heirs
item.description: John Poindexter, 81, founder of J.B. Poindexter & Co., aims to turn Shafter, Texas, into a living history museum.

item.title: After two corporate careers, seeking purpose in Silicon Valley
item.description: Silicon Valley excels at solving problems for the wealthiest in the world's richest society. What about everyone else?
